definitions.explanation: A work schedule system where employees take turns working different time periods, typically covering a 24-hour operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Shift work is standard at the factory.

examples.japanese: {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: With shift work, I have night shifts several times a month.

examples.japanese: {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧や⟦{製造業|せいぞうぎょう}→製造業：14148_seizougyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧⟦{勤務形態|きんむけいたい}→勤務形態：27106_kinmukeitai⟧だ。
examples.english: Shift work takes a heavy toll on the body, but it's an indispensable work arrangement in healthcare and manufacturing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{交替|こうたい}→交替：04146_koutai⟧ (alternation, taking turns) and ⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (work, duty). Also written as {交代勤務|こうたいきんむ} with the variant kanji ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧.

Common in industries that require 24-hour operations: hospitals, factories, police, firefighting, and transportation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三交替|さんこうたい}{勤務|きんむ}: three-shift system (day/evening/night)
- {二交替|にこうたい}{勤務|きんむ}: two-shift system (day/night)
- {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}{手当|てあて}: shift work allowance
- {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シフト→シフト：10934_shifuto⟧: shift rotation schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦シフト→シフト：10934_shifuto⟧⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: shift system — the loanword version, common in service industries
- ⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧: night shift — one specific shift within a rotation
- ⟦{変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}→変則勤務：25086_hensokukinmu⟧: irregular work hours — covers non-standard schedules more broadly
